info.title: REGEN API
info.description: API over the REGEN job engine's append-only event log (read-only, plus POST /api/answers when enabled).

get.description: The run (if one was started from the UI), every applier active in the last 15 minutes, queue, limits.

Container health from heartbeats in the shared workspace (engine/supervisor.py): pipeline, appliers, relay,
supervisor (+ the services it probes), batch queue, lost claims, codes waiting, kill switch, applier limits, the
supervisor's last audit records and which ledger backend the API reads.

The supervisor's container inventory (service, state, uptime, CPU, memory), refreshed every minute; null
when the supervisor is not running (only it holds the Docker socket).

Reach list (engine/discovery/reach.py): Workday / iCIMS / SmartRecruiters jobs with a tailored resume, newest
first, for the user to submit; each row carries the user's own mark (todo / submitted / skipped).

Big-tech portals (engine/discovery/bigtech.py): roles that passed the title filter and fit gate, each with a
tailored resume, read from workspace/bigtech.md (newest first). Applying happens on the company's own portal.

What the Discover station is looking at: boards watched per ATS, the six big-tech portals, and `n` orbs, one
per company with the newest postings in the queue (company, ATS, a role). O(queue).

Copy-ready answers for filling a Workday / iCIMS application by hand (presets + Fact Bank). Personal data:
only for this computer (127.0.0.1-published port in the bank, localhost otherwise).

post.description:
Queue one reach-list Workday job for the desk (engine/apply/workday.py): the desk opens it in the browser you
signed in to and fills it. Same switch and same this-computer rule as /reach/mark.

get.description: Workday employers to sign in to in the desk, most open reach jobs first (one account per employer host).

post.description:
Open one Workday employer's site in the desk and press its Sign In button, so the user signs in there.
Only URLs of employers on the sign-in list are accepted (the desk never opens arbitrary pages from the API).

get.description: The desk's heartbeat (ready / filling, queue length, last result) and its latest results per reach URL.

post.description:
The user marks a reach job submitted / skipped / back to to-do. Recorded as a `reach_mark` event; "submitted"
also records an application event (status SUBMITTED, detail "by you on <ats>") so the engine never re-lists or
re-applies to that role. Needs REGEN_API_REACH=1 (or REGEN_API_WRITE=1) and a request from this computer.

The user finished (or dropped) a parked job by hand on the /desk page: a hCaptcha ticked in the desk, a Lever
CAPTCHA or an Ashby human click on the employer's page. The desk never sees that Submit, so the user's mark is
the record: an application event SUBMITTED / SKIPPED "by you". Only for jobs waiting on the user right now; same
guard as /reach/mark (REGEN_API_REACH=1 and a request from this computer).

get.description:
Shadow's switchboard (engine/shadow.py): mode (calls / always / off), minutes between calls, and every line:
ringing (call 1 / call 2, seconds to the next step) or picked up (by you or by Shadow).

post.description: Set Shadow's mode and ring interval: {"mode": "calls"|"autopilot"|"always"|"off", "ring_min": 0.5-240}.
Answer a ringing line: {"url", "who": "you"|"shadow"}. you = the job waits for you; shadow = Shadow now.

get.description:
Shadow's brain (engine/shadow_brain.py): tuned thresholds, reliability per strategy, the latest train/test run,
the test-precision history, and the ownership ladder with what each locked rung still needs.

post.description: Retrain now: tune on your answers (train split), score on the held-out split. Local only. ~2 s.

get.description:
The agent graph (engine/agents.py): Shadow -> applier / parked-job / service agents -> job agents -> question
agents, each with its owner today, plus the actions Shadow would take now (allowed or locked by the ladder).
Latest benchmark run B1-B7 (engine/bench.py; the supervisor saves one every REGEN_BENCH_HOURS).
Eval history (B1-B10 summaries, oldest first) plus the eval containers the supervisor runs right now.

post.description:
Apply again to jobs that are answerable now (pipeline.answerable_now). If appliers are already working, the
running loop picks them up on its next pass instead (two appliers must not share a browser profile).
Replace title/company filters (regex alternations). Each must compile; the old file is kept as .bak.

get.description: Every rule that drives the engine, grouped by the stage it runs in, with firing counts (engine/rules.py).
The Fact Bank as the UI draws it: every entry, which resumes used it, in which lanes.
A resume PDF the engine built, by file name only, from workspace/out.
Role Keywords: the per-run switch and whether the A/B (which overrides it per posting) is on.

post.description: {"on": true|false}: the same as `engine keywords on|off` (records a `keywords` event).

get.description: Daily cap switch: levels, current level, today's cap and verified-or-not submissions so far.

post.description: {"level": 0..4 | "up" | "down"}: the same as `engine cap ...` (records a `cap` event).
{"key": one of SETTABLE, "value": ...}: one targeting setting (records a `targeting` event).

get.description: OA-or-interview per 100 verified applications with a 95% Wilson interval (`engine report rate`).
`engine report funnel` as data: overall counts and every split with its interval and significance.
Role Keywords A/B: arm counts always; rates only once both arms reach ab_per_arm (no peeking).

post.description: {"company", "role"?}: the USER sent a note (the engine never sends). Same as `engine outreach sent`.

get.description: Outreach drafts built by `engine outreach` (workspace/outreach/drafts.json). Nothing here sends mail.

post.description: Rebuild drafts for submissions in the last `days` days (1-30).

get.description: Gear, clutch, what they set, the feedback loop's learned rules, and the engine's live speed (submissions/hour).

post.description: Shift gear (N, 1-4) and/or set the clutch (on/off). Needs REGEN_API_GEAR=1 (bank) or REGEN_API_WRITE=1.

get.description:
Oil life, what is contaminating it, the change running now (stage by stage) and the last 20 changes. Reads
workspace/oilchange.json, which the supervisor rewrites every 5 minutes and after every stage. O(1).

post.description: Ask the supervisor to change the oil now (it starts within 15 s). Same write gate as the gearbox.

get.description:
Both MCP servers (stdio on your machine, HTTP in the bank), each tool with its level and whether it writes,
and a live initialize probe of the bank's HTTP endpoint. O(tools).

parameters.name: status

schema.description: SUBMITTED, NEEDS YOU, FAILED, FLAGGED, SKIPPED
schema.title: Status

parameters.description: SUBMITTED, NEEDS YOU, FAILED, FLAGGED, SKIPPED

post.description: Answer a waiting question once; the engine reuses it on every form and re-queues the job.

get.description: Answers the engine drafted from the Fact Bank and sent without waiting, newest first.
A proof screenshot, by file name only (no paths), from workspace/proof.
SSE: `narration` for each new event, `snapshot` when anything changes (and every 15 s as a keep-alive).

The engine's memory as a graph: You -> lanes -> applications -> companies, facts used, questions answered,
outcomes, ATS (engine/memory/graph.py; same model as engine/memory/schema.cypher).
Per-station totals, today's count and the latest lines, from one pass over the log: O(E).
Everything the engine did for one posting, in order: resume (facts, coverage, ATS score), attempts, outcome.

AnswerIn.title: AnswerIn
AnswerIn.description: One answer typed in the web app for a question the engine could not answer.

proof.title: Proof
proof.description: Proof screenshot path, only when the file exists on disk

facts.title: Facts
facts.description: Fact Bank ids the resume was built from

Application.title: Application
Application.description: Latest state of one job (later events win).

Drafted.title: Drafted
Drafted.description: An answer the engine drafted from Fact Bank entries and sent without waiting (for review).

id.title: Id
id.description: Position in the log (1-based); stable because the log is append-only

Event.title: Event
Event.description: One line of workspace/events.jsonl, with the fields every consumer relies on lifted out.

missing.title: Missing
missing.description: Questions the engine could not answer (answer them via POST /api/answers)

HumanItem.title: HumanItem
HumanItem.description: Something only the user can do (each job's latest status, never stale history).

Narration.title: Narration
Narration.description: An event as one plain-English sentence (engine.live.server.narrate).
